title: Fish fry rules, parade bands, Chris Kelly, Celestin and a medicine show
summary: Miller finishes on fish fries, police warnings and fines, then recalls parade bands, Chris Kelly's plunger mute, Celestin's band, singers like Bessie Smith, Robichaux, and touring with Earl Foster's medicine show.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
